rustc /app/polyglot/main.rs && g++ -x c++ /app/polyglot/main.rs -o /app/polyglot/cmain && python3 -c '
import subprocess

def py_fib(n):
    a, b = 1, 1
    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return str(a)

for n in [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 20, 46, 47, 87, 88, 92, 93, 94, 100, 200, 1000, 10000]:
    expected = py_fib(n)
    r_out = subprocess.check_output(["/app/polyglot/main", str(n)], text=True)
    c_out = subprocess.check_output(["/app/polyglot/cmain", str(n)], text=True)

print("All tests passed! f(0..5):", [py_fib(i) for i in range(6)])
' && rm -f /app/polyglot/main /app/polyglot/cmain
